# MiTi Studio

> Family-run boutique design studio in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. Brand identity, product
> design, design systems, custom type and illustration. We work in English and German,
> with clients locally and worldwide. Senior work at small studio rates, and you deal
> directly with the founder.

## What we do
- Brand identity design: logos, color systems, complete visual identities.
- UX/UI product design: web and mobile interfaces.
- Design systems: reusable component libraries and documentation.
- Custom font design: display faces and full families.
- Custom illustration: editorial and website artwork.

## Practical
- Location: Baden-Württemberg, Germany. Remote work worldwide.
- Languages: English and German.
- Size: a small family-owned studio. You work with the founder and creative director,
  with no corporate layers in between.
- Good fit for: individuals, small studios and businesses who want senior design work
  without agency overhead.
- Contact: hello@miti.studio. We answer within two working days.
